entities.summary: Robert Kolb is Distinguished Professor and Research Fellow at Christ School of Theology at the Institute of Lutheran Theology, professor emeritus of Systematic Theology at Concordia Seminary, St. Louis, Missouri, and a world-renowned authority on Martin Luther and the history of the Reformation.
